instruction: Convert the Desktop file "Meeting-Agenda.docx" to a PDF document and place it in the meetings directory of my Google Drive account.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting Meeting-Agenda.docx to PDF and uploading to Google Drive. Evaluator performs comprehensive checks: file size >= 5KB, at least 1 page, and contains extractable text.
metadata.verification: Comprehensive validation combining multiple checks to ensure the PDF was properly generated from the meeting agenda document.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: PDF conversion, Google Drive location (meetings directory), and filename (Meeting-Agenda.pdf)
Getter (get_googledrive_file) successfully downloads file from correct Google Drive path using PyDrive API

Metric (check_pdf_comprehensive__6dc3161b) validates three critical aspects: file size >= 5KB (ensures non-empty/non-corrupted), page count >= 1 (valid PDF structure), and text content presence (confirms actual conversion occurred)
Expected values are semantically correct and appropriate for a meeting agenda document
Partial credit logic (0.33 per check) provides granular scoring for different validation aspects
Logic flow is sound: downloads from Google Drive → validates PDF properties → returns appropriate score
Error handling properly returns 0.0 if file doesn't exist or cannot be read

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_pdf_comprehensive__6dc3161b first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_googledrive_file return type (Any)
